Main entry and initialization prototypes for boot configuration and topology setup.

# Purpose
This header file declares the shared boot interface used by application startup code. It includes `fd_config.h` and `fd_config_file.h`, then defines the prototypes for [`fd_main`](<#fd_main>) and [`fd_main_init`](<#fd_main_init>), which take command-line arguments, configuration data, and a topology initialization callback. The [`fd_main`](<#fd_main>) function starts the main application flow, while [`fd_main_init`](<#fd_main_init>) prepares argument state and fills the `config_t` structure before startup. The include guard prevents multiple inclusion of the header file.
